current.text: Isaiah Jackson is starting at center over Lopez in Clippers preseason scrimmages. It is not guaranteed to continue.
He is 38 and in his final season.
He projects as the Clippers' backup center in a mentoring role.
Konan Niederhauser is injured and out. He is the other center competing for minutes.
Do not draft him inside the top 200. His ESPN rank of 112 and ADP of 109 are too high.
He looks washed. At 30 minutes a night he would be a late-round player. If his minutes drop to about 22, he has no fantasy value.
The Clippers lean toward a trial season with long rotations and many players tested. Coach Ty Lue often changes his rotations, which makes minutes for a backup center unstable.
The Clippers' fantasy playoff schedule is good: 4, 3 and 4 games in weeks 19 to 21. They have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league with 13.

durable.text: He still contests shots at the rim but is weak defending the pick and roll.
He is a stretch center. Blocks are his best category, and he adds threes and few turnovers. Steals and rebounds are weak for a center.
He has a record of very few missed games.
